name: id-panel-text
js: (function(){const t=document.querySelector('#panel .content').textContent;return t.startsWith('Howdy guys, my name is Wilson.') && /student card\.\.\.$/.test(t.trim()) && document.querySelectorAll('#panel .content p').length === 4;})()

name: fpga-card
js: (function(){const a=document.querySelector('#panel .content a.linkcard');const img=a&&a.querySelector('img');return !!a && a.href==='https://architectlabs.com/blog/redwood' && a.target==='_blank' && /noopener/.test(a.rel) && !!img && img.complete && img.naturalWidth>0 && !a.classList.contains('no-image') && !document.querySelector('#panel .content .btn') && !document.querySelector('#panel .content mark.todo');})()

name: die-cast-text
js: (function(){const t=document.querySelector('#panel .content').textContent;return t.startsWith('This is a sample part from a Chinese manufacturer') && /Small world!$/.test(t.trim()) && !document.querySelector('#panel .content mark.todo');})()
